abstracts.abstract: To amend sections 2152.02, 2152.16, 2152.17, 2152.203, 2152.22, 2152.26, 2152.82, 2152.84, 2152.86, 2949.12, 5139.01, 5139.05, 5139.10, 5139.101, 5139.50, and 5139.51 and to enact section 2152.161 of the Revised Code to extend the juvenile court's and department of youth services' jurisdiction over delinquent children from twenty-one years of age to twenty-five years of age and to require the department of youth services to commit felons under twenty-five years of age to institutions within the department.

other_titles.title: To amend sections 2152.02, 2152.16, 2152.17, 2152.203, 2152.22, 2152.26, 2152.82, 2152.84, 2152.86, 2949.12, 5139.01, 5139.05, 5139.10, 5139.101, 5139.50, and 5139.51 and to enact section 2152.161 of the Revised Code to extend the juvenile court's and department of youth services' jurisdiction over delinquent children from twenty-one years of age to twenty-five years of age and to require the department of youth services to commit felons under twenty-five years of age to institutions within the department.
